notes:
The tool you pick now survives a dropped message.

**The two tablets could end up on different tools** — you pick the pen on one and the other is still holding the piston stamp. Until now the tool was sent to the other tablet exactly once, when you tapped it, and the radio link does not acknowledge anything. So if that one message was lost, the tablets stayed on different tools until you happened to change tool again or they reconnected. The tablets also suspend every few seconds, which is when a single unacknowledged message is most likely to go missing.

The tool choice is now sent again twice shortly afterwards, and re-asserted whenever the reader comes back to the front — the same treatment page turns have had since August. Each attempt reads whatever the tool actually is at that moment rather than a remembered copy, so a late retry can never set the other tablet back to an older choice.

Worth saying plainly: this fixes the message going missing. If the other tablet is receiving it and not acting on it, this will not help, and the two look the same from where you are standing. The troubleshooting recorder notes every tool message as it arrives, so plugging the tablets in settles which it is.
